user.title: Where your model is released
user.description: The GitHub repository whose releases carry your home's model packages (`home3d-model-HOME-VERSION.zip`), and a token that may read it. For a private repository: a fine-grained token with access to that repository only and the permission Contents: read-only.

reauth_confirm.title: New GitHub token
reauth_confirm.description: GitHub no longer accepts the token for {repository}. Give a new one with read access to it.

progress.download: Downloading model {version}. This can take a minute for a large model.

error.invalid_repository: Give the repository as owner/name or as its GitHub URL.
error.invalid_auth: GitHub refused the token, or the token can't read this repository.
error.no_models: No release of this repository carries a model package (`home3d-model-HOME-VERSION.zip`).
error.path_taken: The sidebar path of this home is used by another panel; rename the home in its model package.

abort.all_added: Every home in this repository is already added.
abort.download_failed: The model could not be installed: {error}
abort.already_in_progress: This home is already being added.

init.title: Lamps and rooms
init.description: Which light is each lamp of the model, and which area each room. Left as suggested, the model's own mapping applies, also after it updates.

lamps.name: Lamps
lamps.description: The light each lamp shows and switches.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: The areas whose temperature and humidity each room shows.

abort.no_model: No model is installed for this home yet.

model_missing.title: {home}: no model installed
model_missing.description: Home 3D could not download the model for {home}: {error}. It tries again at every check (every six hours) and at every start. Check that the repository still has a model package for this home and that the token can read it.

check_failing.title: {home}: updates not checked for a day
check_failing.description: Home 3D has not reached {repository} for over a day ({error}). The installed model keeps working; newer ones appear once the repository can be reached again.
